formula: log1p(daily)+alpha*(log1p(bounded full ridge)-log1p(daily)); no second clipping; exact endpoints
month_end: is_last_trading_day_month AND NOT monthly_options_expiry AND NOT quarterly_options_expiry, matching previous disjoint event diagnostics
low_liquidity: prior-information liquidity_percentile < 1/3; missing percentile treated as not low and reported
segments: Targeted variants retain full update outside target. Combined has separate month_end_only, low_only, intersection strengths. Sparse target cells use global strength.
fitting: Rebuild original tuning ridge on saved tune rows with original selected penalty, predict saved historical validation rows; choose alpha minimizing validation mean squared log error; ties prefer alpha 1 (less change). Same historical validation selects original penalty and shrinkage, not a new nested calibration split. Final full ridge and anchor are unchanged saved forecasts.
chronology: 2022 validation Q4 2021; later years previous full year, using saved reservoir sample; only earlier labels fit alpha
fallback: Exact daily fallback when checkpoint missing, inherited from both endpoints
evaluation: Equal-year 2022-2024 development decision saved before scoring previously inspected 2025. No 2025 choice of variants or strength.
adoption_gate: Versus full ridge: development mean log RMSE gain >=0.002, no annual worsening >0.002, no mean WAPE worsening, 20-date paired log-MAE upper CI <0. Versus daily: no annual log RMSE worsening >0.002, no mean WAPE worsening. Pick lowest development RMSE among passers, else retain full.
bootstrap: 2000 within-year moving 20-trading-date blocks; equal-year mean daily log-MAE difference; unadjusted exploratory multiple comparisons
limits: Hypotheses were motivated by inspected development diagnostics, so this is retrospective research. No production claim, new external data or new ridge fitting policy. Q4 validation may force sparse month-end cell fallback.
